title: Adyghe & Kabardian Language Resources
description: Reference material for the Circassian languages Adyghe (ady) and Kabardian (kbd): transliteration tables between Cyrillic and Turkish Latin, and related documentation. Every character is given with its Unicode codepoint so that the palochka (U+04C0 / U+04CF) cannot be confused with the Latin characters commonly typed in its place.
